import_reading_progress: Reading data from {0}: {1} members so far...
import_preview_members_xp: Found {0} members. {1} of them already have XP here.
import_preview_members_currency: Found {0} members. {1} of them already have a balance here.
import_preview_curve_switch: This server switches to the {0} curve, so every member keeps the exact same level and XP.
import_preview_curve_convert: Members keep their levels and progress on this server's {0} curve.
import_preview_curve_raw: {0} has no level formula, so XP is copied as is onto this server's {1} curve.
import_merge_add: imported values are added on top
import_preview_confirm: Write this to the server? You can undo it for 24 hours.
import_done_sync: Reward roles are being handed out in the background.
import_undo_hint: Changed your mind? Run /import undo within 24 hours.
import_undone: Undid the {0} import from {1}. Everything it changed is back.
import_error_source_failed: {0} did not answer properly. Try again in a few minutes.
import_error_leaderboard_private: This server's MEE6 leaderboard is private. Make it public in the MEE6 dashboard under Leaderboard, then try again.
import_error_not_found: {0} has no data for this server.
import_error_key_required: {0} needs an API key. Add one with the api-key option.
import_error_file_required: Attach the file you exported from {0}.
import_error_rate_limited: {0} is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
import_error_unreadable_file: That file could not be read. Use a JSON or CSV export with a user ID and an XP or level for each member.
import_error_empty: No members were found in that data.
import_error_global_currency: This bot shares one balance across every server, so balances cannot be imported into one server.
import_error_busy: Another import is already running on this server.
import_error_job_missing: There is no import to undo.
import_error_not_ready: That import is not ready yet.
import_error_wrong_kind: That data does not match this kind of import. XP goes through /import xp and balances through /import currency.
import_error_undo_expired: That import can no longer be undone. Imports can be undone for 24 hours.
import_error_undo_not_latest: A newer import has to be undone first.
import_error_wrong_server: That file was exported from a different server. Run the export on this server's MEE6 dashboard.
